summary: Bitterroot NF 20-ft L-4 tower near Stevensville, MT, from the 1930s; destroyed or removed in 1961 (sources differ); no site description today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1961 per firelookout.com; removed in 1961 per Forest Lookouts; FFLA lists Tower Gone. No source describes the site now.

staffing.status: listed as known lookout personnel: Laura Roberts

events.note: Laura Roberts listed as known lookout personnel
Removed per Forest Lookouts; conflicts with 'destroyed' on firelookout.com

evidence.supports: 1930s 20-foot L-4 tower; destroyed 1961; Laura Roberts in 1945
evidence.quote: 1930s: 20' L-4 tower. Destroyed 1961. Known lookout personnel: 1945: Laura Roberts.

evidence.supports: Laura Roberts named as known lookout personnel in 1945
Forest Lookouts page says removed in 1961
FFLA lists the tower as gone
Forest Lookouts page gives the Bitterroot National Forest and no site description
Survey location 8N-18W-20 on the Forest Lookouts page

resolved_conflicts.explanation: All three sources agree the tower is gone. They differ only on destroyed versus removed in 1961, which the story reports as a disagreement.

notes_for_editor: Destroyed (firelookout.com) and removed (Forest Lookouts) conflict for 1961; unresolved. Only the 1930s build decade is given, so no built event was recorded. The 20-ft height is converted to 6.1 m. Elevation 6,655 ft (about 2,029 m, converted) could fill elevation_m. A 2021 Sanders County Ledger lookout feature mentions a different 'Squaw Peak' in Sanders County; it is not this site and was not used.
